purpose: Consolidate existing local permissions and authorize bounded autonomous correction through remaining V0/V1; stop at human gates, no per-candidate GPU confirmation within scope.
stage_policy: Only the already-approved development route and frozen product obligations. Historical S0/S1/R1a signatures and failures are not rewritten or re-signed. No new Stage IDs to reset budgets. Cross-Stage/human gates remain mandatory.
allowed: Read/write project code, templates, docs, tests and local Git commits/worktrees for the approved Stage; no unrequested business refactor.
Use existing local GPU, installed Ollama/ComfyUI/FastAPI/FFmpeg/SQLite, headless Chromium, portable/isolated install-rollback tests, bounded failure injection and original-process cleanup.
Read already-authorized non-private testSource, generated fixtures and already-downloaded permitted development assets; bind inputs before real execution.
Read installed model/tool metadata and locate existing moved weights read-only; no weight copying/migration/download or permanent config modification.

Extend the temporary Codex implementation role through V1 within existing platform/tool access; independent review remains a separate read-only instance and human signatures remain human. Do not create new paid accounts/API routes or read/modify secrets under this permission.
Automatically reseal corrected candidate and harness within the same approved product scope, then derive a fresh bounded child without requesting human approval for every SHA.

Gate owner may version internal Stage implementation details, prompts/input organization preserving all sampled source data, startup/waiters/UI wiring and test precision; preserve public contract semantics, fixed denominator and thresholds. Require independent review; do not weaken failed assertions.
Independent CPU recomputation and candidate/evidence checks; every real media/service/GPU/browser operation still needs a pre-issued finite child.
After an actual human Stage acceptance, use the existing standing permission for ordinary commit/push to the configured remote; no force push/merge/release.
protected_inputs: source candidate, harness and gate scripts
public contracts and fixed acceptance/spec hashes
system prompt/templates and actual shared video kernel source
sample hashes, endpoints/ports, original process handle or PID+birth+nonce
action/time budgets, cleanup plan and unique run identity

budget_policy.child_actual_budget: Use the frozen packet actual budget and the remaining program allowance, whichever is smaller. These ceilings never authorize filling unused calls or expanding tests. Current unified sequence remains max8/1800s, normally3 calls.
budget_policy.model_action_definition: Every attempted inference send and intentional preload/warm-load counts, including connection failure after send-attempt, timeout, refusal, invalid output and cancellation. Pure tags/ps/status/unload do not count as inference but retain bounded request/action/time budgets.
budget_policy.effective_full_claim: Atomically claim at the first model inference/preload send-attempt, not at API/browser startup or readiness metadata. Once claimed, failure consumes it.
budget_policy.zero_model_startup_definition: Verified zero model send/preload attempts; startup/readiness/resource/UI/setup failure only. Consume a zero-model startup count and actual service/time budget; preserve NO_GO, expire that child. Never relabel an old consumed run.
budget_policy.same_failure_rule: Two effective repairs on the same route without new evidence/progress stop that route. Diagnose or change implementation within scope before another full run; do not retry identically to spend remaining allowance.
budget_policy.budget_exhaustion: WAIT_BUDGET/WAIT_AUTH with an exact increment request; do not lower quality, denominator or required checks.
budget_policy.checkpoint_scheduling: One consolidated full acceptance at Stage end; no full E2E after each edit/Workpack. The remaining two Stage slots are corrective rechecks only after material repairs/new evidence; once passed, stop at the human gate.

model_and_resource_policy.existing_visual_model: gemma4:26b, bind actual identity per child; no provider/model switch or downloads under this grant
model_and_resource_policy.threshold_changes: none; inherit the active packet actual workload, image/video context/predict limits, GPU/RAM/latency/release/quality rules
model_and_resource_policy.resource_shortage: WAIT_RESOURCE; do not call it missing human permission and do not terminate other processes.

forbidden: V2/V3 or other projects actual execution
private media, Cookies, existing browser profiles
test or tune the 11 frozen human holdout videos with models before human review
change product goals/non-goals/public contract semantics/fixed denominator/quality or resource thresholds without explicit product approval
fabricate logs, remove failed cases, replace a failed sample or call skipped/blocked PASS
force push, remote merge or production publish
self-sign human experience or release approval
git_exception: Only the pre-existing post-human-acceptance ordinary push permission in AGENTS16 is retained. This does not permit current unaccepted code to be pushed or published.
stage_and_human_gates: Stop for independent review and human experience/release signatures as required. This program supplies local execution permission, not Stage PASS, UX signoff or automatic cross-Stage product approval.
supersedes_prospectively: Prior per-run human GPU/code-verification requests within this local V0/V1 scope
Prior human approval requirement for every corrective candidate SHA within unchanged approved public contracts
Earlier authorization-only checkpoint/recheck caps in this same scope, replaced by these explicit new cumulative ceilings after approval
supersession_limits: No historical grant is revived or refunded. Existing V0 broader scope outside these listed stages is not expanded. Within overlapping stages these new budgets are the unified limits; old grants cannot be combined to bypass them.
activation: Only after the project owner explicitly approves this complete request. Save request-hash-bound approval, update governance executor/ledger and independently test counting/freeze/default-deny before any next real model run. Do not require a second RUNTIME-01 approval if covered.
expires_when: final V1 human product acceptance completes
project owner revokes or explicitly replaces the program
out_of_scope_handling: Stop the offending action and request the missing scope; do not assume authorization. A child terminal, ordinary NO_GO or WAIT_RESOURCE alone does not revoke this parent.
implementation_role_extension: Proposed extension beyond the historical until-V0 exception, effective only after approval of this complete program.
